requirement.statement: Headless exec SHALL provide an explicit bounded auto-resume mode for resumable `paused_with_progress` turns; internal continuations MUST NOT append new user input.

case.given: a turn pauses with `runtime_turn_unsettled:*` after making progress
case.when: headless exec is run with auto-resume enabled
case.then: the runtime SHALL be resumed without adding a new user message
headless exec SHALL continue until final output, hard failure, no-progress pause, or the continuation limit

case.given: a turn pauses with `runtime_turn_unsettled:*` after making progress
case.when: headless exec is run without auto-resume
